es: Proponer respuestas para dos problemas probables.
Redactar un plan A/B de 60–80 palabras.

teaching.en: A contingency gives a practical response to a likely problem.
teaching.es: Una contingencia da una respuesta práctica a un problema probable.
teaching.explanationEs: Contingency conecta riesgo real y acción viable.
teaching.audioText: A contingency gives a practical response to a likely problem.

teaching.en: If the road floods, our backup will be the hill route.
teaching.es: Si se inunda la carretera, la alternativa será la ruta alta.
teaching.explanationEs: Flood activa un backup que todavía permite viajar.

teaching.en: When transport is confirmed, update the group.

teaching.audioText: If the train is cancelled, use the bus route instead.

prompt.es: Elige un plan A/B con dos problemas y dos respuestas.

choices.text: If it rains, we will visit the museum; if buses stop, we will take the metro.
If it rains, we will visit the museum; the buses may also stop.
We will check the weather and the buses before deciding.

feedback.es: El plan contiene dos condiciones reales y una respuesta viable para cada una.

hint.es: Cuenta dos problemas y dos acciones diferentes.

answer.text: If the beach closes, we will use the indoor pool.

feedback.es: El cierre activa una alternativa interior concreta.

hint.es: Mantén presente tras if y will en la acción.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada riesgo con su alternativa.

feedback.es: Cada alternativa responde al riesgo sin depender de datos nuevos.

hint.es: Elige acciones que todavía permitan realizar la salida.

prompt.es: Escribe dos contingencias para una excursión al lago.

answer.text: If it rains, we will visit the nature centre. If the train is cancelled, we will take the 8:10 bus.
accepted: If it rains, we will visit the nature centre. If the train is cancelled, we will take the 8:10 bus.
We will visit the nature centre if it rains, and we will take the 8:10 bus if the train is cancelled.

feedback.es: Las variantes conservan los dos riesgos y sus dos soluciones.

origin.text: Problema 1: lluvia; alternativa: centro natural. Problema 2: tren cancelado; alternativa: bus 8:10.

accepted: If it rains, we will use the covered gallery. If the funicular closes, we will take the 9:30 mountain bus.
We will use the covered gallery if it rains, and take the 9:30 mountain bus if the funicular closes.

prompt.es: Escribe 60–80 palabras para el plan A/B de la salida costera.

answer.text: Our coastal trip is on Saturday. If the rain is heavy, we will visit the aquarium at ten. If the train is cancelled, we will take the 9:15 bus. We will check the forecast at seven and confirm transport at 7:30. At 7:45, we will message the group. Unless the café confirms that it is open, everyone will bring lunch.
accepted: Our coastal trip is on Saturday. If the rain is heavy, we will visit the aquarium at ten. If the train is cancelled, we will take the 9:15 bus. We will check the forecast at seven and confirm transport at 7:30. At 7:45, we will message the group. Unless the café confirms that it is open, everyone will bring lunch.

On Saturday, we will check the coastal forecast at seven. If heavy rain starts, the group will meet at the aquarium at ten. If our train is cancelled, we will use the 9:15 bus instead. We will confirm the service at 7:30 and update everyone fifteen minutes later. Everyone will pack lunch unless the café confirms that it will open.

feedback.es: El plan integra dos riesgos, respuestas viables, horas y comunicación ordenada.

origin.text: Salida sábado. Riesgo 1: lluvia fuerte; alternativa: acuario 10:00. Riesgo 2: tren cancelado; alternativa: bus 9:15. Revisar clima 7:00, confirmar transporte 7:30, avisar grupo 7:45. Llevar comida salvo que café confirme apertura.

prompt.es: Escribe 60–80 palabras para el plan de una visita al valle.

answer.text: Our valley visit is on Sunday. If the fog is thick, we will meet at the local museum at eleven. If the bus is full, we will book two taxis for 10:20. We will check visibility at eight and call the bus company at 8:15. At 8:30, we will update the group. Everyone will carry water unless the visitor centre confirms that it sells drinks.
accepted: Our valley visit is on Sunday. If the fog is thick, we will meet at the local museum at eleven. If the bus is full, we will book two taxis for 10:20. We will check visibility at eight and call the bus company at 8:15. At 8:30, we will update the group. Everyone will carry water unless the visitor centre confirms that it sells drinks.

On Sunday, we will check the valley visibility at eight. If fog covers the road, the group will visit the local museum at eleven. If there are no bus seats, two taxis will collect us at 10:20. We will call the company at 8:15 and message everyone at 8:30. We will bring water unless the visitor centre confirms that drinks are available.

feedback.es: La recuperación mantiene riesgos nuevos, secuencia horaria y dos soluciones completas.

origin.text: Visita domingo. Riesgo 1: niebla; alternativa: museo local 11:00. Riesgo 2: autobús lleno; alternativa: dos taxis 10:20. Revisar visibilidad 8:00, llamar bus 8:15, informar grupo 8:30. Llevar agua salvo que centro la venda.
